scope: Code/test-only LAN pilot; no deployment or credential provisioning performed.

GET /api/auth/session.loginFactorProfile: Optional totp-sha256-8 only for TLS live v3 named authority. Omitted for static v1/v2/development. Server-wide protocol support, not an individual account lookup.

POST /api/auth/login.requirements: Dedicated LAN operator surface. TLS by default; explicit HTTP-test profile only with independent test auth/state. Exact configured Origin/Host, application/json, <=4096 raw bytes; no pre-login CSRF token needed. No CORS. Named mode requires both username and password; shared mode requires password only. Unknown, duplicate, missing or client-supplied actor/role/capability fields are rejected. Unknown names perform bounded dummy hashing and never fall back to shared authentication.
POST /api/auth/login.response: Session view above, authenticated=true, per-session csrfToken, expiresAt and expiresInSeconds. Named sessions carry a server-derived stable actorId and explicit capabilities; shared sessions carry null actorId and read-only display capability, with existing legacy administration semantics. Anonymous views disclose only loginMode, null actorId and an empty capability list.
POST /api/auth/login.cookie: TLS: __Host-tracebolt-session, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/, no Domain. HTTP test: tracebolt-http-test-session, same properties except Secure=false. Token only in Set-Cookie, never JSON.
POST /api/auth/login.semantics: Existing cookie session revoked on successful login; session and CSRF both rotate. Default absolute expiry30min, no silent sliding extension. TLS live v3 additionally accepts optional otp, required in effect for an explicitly factor-bound account. Password and unused TOTP must both validate; consumption is durable before session output and does not change the account epoch. Pending factor re-enrollment never falls back to password-only. Static v1/v2 reject otp. See docs/live-operator-factors.md; no browser MFA UI acceptance is implied. Live v3 session views expose loginFactorProfile=totp-sha256-8. Cockpit OTP-input source is present but its frontend compilation/build acceptance is still pending. Durable factor-consumption uncertainty returns503/account_authority_uncertain, not ordinary401; affected account remains fenced and clients must not blindly retry.

shared.password: 12..1024 UTF-8 bytes; never persisted or logged

named.username: 1..64 ASCII bytes; exact configured lowercase username
named.password: 12..1024 UTF-8 bytes; never persisted or logged
named.otp: TLS live v3 only, optional JSON field; factor-bound account requires an unused eight-digit TOTP-SHA256 proof. Absent/invalid proof never creates a session. Static v2 rejects this field.

POST /api/auth/logout.requirements: Authenticated profile-specific cookie + per-session X-CSRF-Token + exact configured Origin/Host + application/json.
POST /api/auth/logout.response: Unauthenticated LAN session view; cookie cleared with matching __Host attributes.
POST /api/auth/logout.semantics: Revokes this session and cancels its active analysis. All concurrent logout calls wait for already admitted short mutations to drain; new mutations are denied. No auth mutex/lease is held during provider network calls. No automatic replay after reauthentication.

routes.GET /api/session: Compatibility endpoint: development returns existing process CSRF; LAN requires authentication and returns the current session CSRF.
routes.GET /api/lan/agents: Authenticated operator: public certificate approval registry; never private keys.

body.certificatePEM: bounded public client leaf and optional intermediate certificates only
body.label: 1..120 UTF-8 bytes
body.expectedFingerprintSHA256: exact lowercase leaf SHA256 from an independently checked source

POST /api/lan/agents/approve.requirements: Legacy shared v1 mode only. Authenticated session mutation lease + exact Origin/CSRF + strict JSON <=65536 bytes; registry validates chain, role, expiry and key strength. HTTP test transport accepts Ed25519 leaf keys directly issued by configured roots.

POST /api/lan/agents/{id}/revoke.requirements: Legacy shared v1 mode only. Same authenticated mutation boundary; durable tombstone; later telemetry commits rejected.

GET /api/alerts/settings.requirements: Authenticated LAN session. Sanitized host/status only; no URL path/query or credentials. Complete guided Linux profile supports managed setup; CLI alarm-config is read-only and takes precedence.
GET /api/alerts/settings.response: tracebolt.alarm-settings.v1: mode, revision, configured, enabled, destinationHost, test (eventId/state/createdAt or null), blocked.

POST /api/alerts/settings.requirements: Legacy shared administrator or explicit named manage_alarms grant; exact Origin/Host, CSRF, strict JSON <=6144 bytes; current revision; explicit destination/payload acknowledgement; separate plaintext acknowledgement for isolated HTTP-test. No provider I/O during request.

body.endpoint: write-only public HTTPS443 URL only for replace, empty otherwise
body.payloadSharingAcknowledged: true for replace/enable, false for disable
body.plaintextAcknowledged: required true on HTTP-test replace/enable, false for disable

POST /api/alerts/settings.response: Sanitized settings view; settings persist in private manager state. Saving enables only future eligible transitions and sends no automatic test.

POST /api/alerts/test.requirements: Same explicit alarm-admin/session/Origin/CSRF boundary, enabled browser-managed settings; strict JSON <=512 bytes. One outstanding test and one new test/minute.
POST /api/alerts/test.response: Sanitized settings view with queued fixed synthetic test. Worker later uses guarded outbox/HTTPS transport. Provider acceptance does not prove human receipt; uncertain attempts are not replayed.

GET /api/application-checks/status.requirements: Any authenticated LAN read session. No queries; retained redacted snapshot only. Never exposes URLs, hostnames, ports or allowlists and never probes targets.
GET /api/application-checks/status.response: tracebolt.application-checks.v1|v2 retained status: enabled, management-server vantage and bounded typed observations.

GET /api/application-checks/settings.requirements: Legacy shared administrator or explicit named manage_application_checks grant, checked under the current session gate. No body/query. This privileged destination-review DTO is never available to named read-only or unrelated-capability users. No network work.
GET /api/application-checks/settings.response: tracebolt.application-check-settings.v1: mode (managed|external|unavailable), revision, configured, enabled, blocked, intervalSeconds, targets (exact existing v2 typed targets). Omitted startup file selects persisted managed settings, initially empty and disabled; supplied startup files, including disabled files, remain read-only external mode.

POST /api/application-checks/settings.requirements: Same explicit application-check administrator authority; exact Origin/Host, CSRF, current session and revision; application/json <=32768 bytes. Reject duplicate/null/unknown/case-alias fields and inappropriate operation fields. No test/probe route. Target validation and persistence are inert; the separate joined supervisor owns outbound checks.

save.targets: 1..8 strict v2 HTTP/HTTPS, DNS or TCP target objects with existing consent/allowlist policy; acknowledgement fields forbidden

enable.plaintextAcknowledged: required true for isolated HTTP-test transport; optional false for TLS; intervalSeconds and targets forbidden

POST /api/application-checks/settings.response: Current SettingsView. Save always disables, enable is separate, disable retains the draft. Every accepted change rotates revision; stale/busy changes return409. Unsafe unavailable/external/blocked state returns503. Invalid input returns400. No error echoes targets or raw errors.

GET /api/auth/accounts.requirements: TLS v3 live account authority only. Authenticated named session with current manage_accounts; no query or request body. Static v1/v2 return404.

response.items: Bounded sorted list of id, revision, revocationFloor, disabled, uncertain and capabilities; factor-bound accounts additionally expose factorState and factorGeneration. No usernames, verifiers, factor secrets/history, OTPs, tokens or proposal paths.

POST /api/auth/accounts/update.requirements: TLS v3 only; current authenticated manage_accounts, exact configured Origin/Host, per-session CSRF, application/json and strict object <=4096 bytes. Reject duplicate/unknown/null required fields. Static v1/v2 return404.

body.expectedRevision: positive integer; exact current target account revision
body.capabilities: required complete explicit replacement list; read remains mandatory
body.resetSessions: required boolean; session reset is not an MFA-factor reset
body.resetPassword: required boolean; true reads a separately provisioned protected proposal bound to authority, actor and revision; no password, verifier or path accepted in HTTP

POST /api/auth/accounts/update.semantics: Every accepted update advances the target epoch/floor, cancels its sessions and drains existing admissions with durable revision/audit. Last enabled account administrator cannot be removed. Self-update clears its cookie; unrelated accounts remain available. Password rotation preserves Argon2 work factors. Already delivered irreversible permits cannot be recalled. No account creation, rename, MFA-factor operation or automatic retry.

errors.503: account_authority_uncertain; target remains fenced; preserve state and inspect before recovery

POST /api/auth/factors/enroll.requirements: TLS live v3 only. Exact Origin/Host, application/json, strict object <=4096 bytes. No ambient-cookie authority or pre-login CSRF; current account password, protected exact-bound proposal and new-factor possession are all required. Disabled/uncertain/active-factor accounts cannot use it to bypass reset.

body.username: exact existing username; derives actor on server
body.otp: unused eight-digit proof of separately provisioned TOTP-SHA256 factor
body.expectedRevision: exact positive current account revision, also pinned by protected proposal

POST /api/auth/factors/enroll.semantics: No cookie issued. Advances account epoch, cancels target sessions/old approvals, audits actual self-authenticated actor and consumes enrollment code. Fresh subsequent OTP required for login; retired factor secrets cannot be re-enrolled. No caller-supplied secret/path or automatic recovery.

POST /api/auth/accounts/reset-factor.requirements: TLS live v3, current named manage_accounts session, exact Origin/Host, per-session CSRF, strict application/json object <=4096 bytes. Fresh password AND unused factor proof of the requester are additionally required, not credentials of the target.

body.actorId: existing target account, never requester identity
body.otp: fresh unused requester's eight-digit TOTP-SHA256 proof

POST /api/auth/accounts/reset-factor.semantics: Durably consumes proof, rechecks short proof freshness/current authority after actor drain, audits actual requester, increments target factor generation/account epoch and cancels target sessions/approvals. Last usable administrator protected; unrelated accounts continue. Pending target cannot sign in password-only and must perform protected re-enrollment. No retry, factor-history deletion or implicit MFA downgrade.

modeBehavior.development: Existing loopback-only guard remains unchanged. GET auth/session explicitly says authenticationRequired=false, authenticated=false, csrfToken=current process token, expiry=null. No fake authentication. Login/logout routes are disabled.
modeBehavior.lan: Dedicated authenticated operator handler. Unauthenticated auth/session is200, protected APIs401. Static assets may load without data. Actual TLS required in the default profile, never inferred from forwarded headers. HTTP test accepts plaintext only, has its own cookie/state/auth profile and permanent warning. Developer ingress is unavailable in either profile.
modeBehavior.named: Named loginMode supports protected static v2 and explicit TLS-only v3; the session metadata format is unchanged. All operators explicitly require read. Existing GET/HEAD views and exact journal/query or inventory/{system,overview,packages,complete-updates}/query POSTs are readable; these POSTs retain Origin/CSRF checks. Logout is allowed. Other legacy administrative writes are denied; none of the new grants implies those rights. Static v1/v2 expose no live account-management API. Static v2 configuration changes take effect only after manager restart; all in-memory sessions then disappear. Explicit manage_alarms additionally admits the exact alarm settings/test routes; unrelated administrative routes remain denied. Application-check settings GET and POST both require the separate manage_application_checks grant; application-check status remains readable without destinations. V3 current manage_accounts explicitly admits the account GET/update routes below through protected journal revisions and audit. Other operators need not restart. V3 is provisioned separately and never inferred from editing a v2 file; see docs/live-operator-authority.md. Explicit optional TOTP enrollment/reset APIs and profile-gated cockpit OTP login source is described in docs/live-operator-factors.md; this does not complete #140 or establish browser/deployment acceptance.

errors.401: invalid_credentials or authentication_required; response never echoes password
errors.403: wrong Origin/Host/CSRF or insecure transport or operator_capability_required for ungranted administrative/maintenance operation

uiRules: Bootstrap failure must fail closed; never guess authentication is disabled.
Protected401 clears visible app data, pending requests, API-key/password drafts and CSRF cache before showing sign-in. Do not replay the interrupted write after login.
Use serverNow/expiresInSeconds for display; backend expiry remains authoritative.
Clear password input when submitting; never persist secrets in browser storage or repopulate from responses.
Render logout as a real CSRF-protected POST; abort and clear session-owned UI state.
Configured LAN mode is not deployment evidence. Tests use temporary loopback TLS fixtures only.
Show a permanent localized plaintext credentials/data and server-impersonation warning on sign-in and throughout the app when insecureTestMode=true.
Render username only when validated loginMode is named; keep that mode through session-expiry and lock paths. Shared login stays password-only.
Actor/capability metadata is display-only and never sent as proof of authorization. Older session payloads may omit the entire metadata tuple; partially present or contradictory metadata is invalid.

If present, loginFactorProfile must be exactly totp-sha256-8 with named/LAN/HTTPS and no insecure test mode. Optional OTP stays an eight-digit string, blank otp is omitted, and code drafts are cleared at submit/lock/bootstrap/logout/user or visibility changes. Source review does not establish frontend build or browser acceptance.

capabilities.read: Explicit read/query access as mapped above. No new collection or unrelated administration.
capabilities.plan_updates: Future typed package planning; currently inert.
capabilities.execute_updates: Future approved typed package execution; currently inert.
capabilities.restart_service: Future approved typed service restart; currently inert.
capabilities.manage_alarms: Explicit alarm configuration and synthetic-test permission, with separately acknowledged destination/payload and complete-profile managed setup.
capabilities.manage_application_checks: Explicit application-check destination review and save/enable/disable permission. No existing grant implies it. No account/grant provisioning; no direct test/probe action.
capabilities.manage_accounts: Explicit current TLS v3 authority to list and update existing accounts through the account API. No grant implies it; manage_sessions is distinct. Static v1/v2 expose no account API even if this grant is present in a named provisioning seed.
